registration.statement: A one-component two-phase boundary is the exact finite ordered word of complete coexistence points. At each point the component exchange supports of the two held phases are equal; the phase-rule relation leaves one independent held coordinate support. For a stable liquid-vapor successor, exact temperature and pressure supports are co-ordered. No differential equation, interpolated continuum or fitted slope enters.
registration.title: One-component finite phase-boundary relation
